A Python orchestrator for bounded, evidence-backed AI coding workflows. Multi-provider (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Omnirush, Copilot). Under active development.

---

## What this does

- Routes roles to CLI providers through validated packets
- Records every attempt in a local SQLite ledger
- Requires evidence before state moves forward
